research_notes: Blocked: public department spell dated only to years with unresolved full-time/secondment status. Board roles and union jobs do not contribute to the two narrow headlines.
Official, personal, employer annual-report and regulator-hosted union evidence checked. Public LinkedIn returned 999; no bypass attempted.

Some secondary sources conflate 2006 and 2016 departmental secondment, and party biography gives 2017 branch-secretary timing against APH May 2018. Retain official dates pending primary appointment confirmation.
Direct full-time evidence found for one excluded union reporting interval; this is not transferred to the 2016–2017 department role. Earlier ASU dates still need primary confirmation.

Follow-up2026-10-02: added explicitly part-time Safeway first job, organiser start2000, confirmed department and Trades Hall secondments, recovered Vision exact board/chair dates and deputy role, and Equal Workplaces advisory membership.

Searches of official/state, union, employer and conference records did not resolve department hours, payroll or exact secondment dates, or early ASU promotion dates.2006 date in derivative biographies remains unadopted.2024 Vision fees paid to union are not personal full-time employment evidence.

Follow-up2026-10-03: regulator records now observe the assistant-secretary title by1 January2008, establish the exact25 July2014 president transition, the exact26 June2018 branch-secretary transition and2 June2024 cessation, and directly label the secretary as a full-time officer for1 July2022–2 June2024. Union work remains outside the two headline sectors.

Next follow-up: DPC appointment/secondment agreement or staff biography; primary election record for the original assistant-secretary appointment and evidence for work status outside the directly reported union intervals. Preserve headline nulls pending supported public FT interval; partial private job is not proof of zero lifetime FT work.
